a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: I operate until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each. Storms make waiting risky, but grabbing the 4 now would leave one of us with nothing. Please operate too so we reach 8 in two rounds.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: Operating now. Once the reserve hits 8 we each take exactly 4.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.
